title: Pay an annual liquor licence fee
summary: This page provides instructions and details on how to pay your annual liquor licence fee online, at a Service NSW Centre, or by phone.
intro:
Annual liquor licence fees are calculated on 15 March each year using licence information held by the NSW Government on that date.

Your fee notice will be sent to you by email and mail. If you haven't got your fee notice by late April 2026, call us on 1300 024 720.

You can pay your fee online or at a Service NSW Centre or by phone.

For up-to-date liquor licence guidelines, resources and tools visit Liquor & Gaming NSW liquor licensing.

If you have questions or feedback about liquor licensing contact Liquor & Gaming NSW.
what_you_need: MyServiceNSW account (if paying by the Liquor Licence Manager)
payment reference number as detailed on your payment notice (if paying by the payment portal)

how_to_steps.text: Go to the Liquor Licence Manager.
Log in with your MyServiceNSW Account.
Select the licences you are paying for.
Follow the prompts to pay your liquor licence fee.
Enter your licence number and payment reference number.
Review the payment amount and select 'Proceed to payment'.
Find your nearest service centre and check payment methods accepted at that centre.
Bring your fee notice and make the payment in person.

faqs.q: When are annual liquor licence fees calculated?
faqs.a: Annual liquor licence fees are calculated on 15 March each year using licence information held by the NSW Government on that date.

faqs.q: How will I receive my fee notice?
faqs.a: Your fee notice will be sent to you by email and mail. If you haven't received it by late April 2026, call 1300 024 720.

faqs.q: What do I need to pay my liquor licence fee?
faqs.a: You will need a MyServiceNSW account (if paying by the Liquor Licence Manager), your liquor licence number, a payment reference number (if paying by the payment portal), and your fee payment.
